title: STAIN-FL: Stealthy Targeted Attack Injection with Contextual Triggers in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated video anomaly detection trains model collaboratively without sharing raw surveillance footage, but limited server-side visibility lets compromised clients to inject backdoor via malicious updates. This paper introduces STAIN-FL, a stealthy targeted backdoor attack injection framework that uses naturally occurring surveillance conditions, including low-light scenes, indoor settings, and crowd density, as contextual triggers. STAIN-FL combines anomaly-to-benign label \textit{manipulation} with gradient masking over least-updated coordinates to preserve clean accuracy while inducing trigger-conditioned misclassification. We evaluate STAIN-FL on \texttt{UCF-Crime} using 1024-dimensional I3D features in a non-IID four-client multi-agency setting, comparing FedAvg and FedProx under sparse and continuous attacks. translated_title: STAIN-FL：联邦学习中使用上下文触发器的隐蔽定向攻击注入
translated_abstract: 联邦视频异常检测通过协作训练模型而不共享原始监控录像，但服务器端有限的可见性使受损客户端能够通过恶意更新注入后门。本文介绍了STAIN-FL，一种隐蔽的定向后门攻击注入框架，该框架利用自然发生的监控条件（如低光场景、室内环境和人群密度）作为上下文触发器。STAIN-FL将异常到正常的标签操纵与对最少更新坐标的梯度掩蔽相结合，以保持干净精度同时诱导触发条件性误分类。我们在UCF-Crime数据集上使用1024维I3D特征，在非独立同分布的四客户端多机构设置中评估了STAIN-FL，并在稀疏和连续攻击下比较了FedAvg和FedProx。结果表明，稀疏攻击具有低可检测性，且能产生操作性显著攻击而非高强度攻击。
tldr: STAIN-FL提出了一种利用监控场景自然条件作为上下文触发器的隐蔽后门攻击方法，通过标签操纵和梯度掩蔽在保持模型精度的同时实现低检测率的定向误分类。
en_tdlr: STAIN-FL proposes a stealthy backdoor attack method using natural surveillance conditions as contextual triggers, achieving low-detectability targeted misclassification via label manipulation and gradient masking while preserving model accuracy.
